exact_target: Bar-Natan Problem2.27 asks whether the ideal of finite-type link invariants vanishing on the actual-link common zero set of an arbitrary ideal I always equals radical(I). The candidate fixes characteristic-zero coefficients, in particular C, and links with at least two components.
